notablePrerequisites: Lands you control except Conqueror's Foothold can tap to produce at least {10}{G}.
description:
Activate any number of lands you control except Conqueror's Foothold by tapping them, adding at least {10}{G}.
Cast Rude Awakening by paying {4}{G}, untapping all lands you control.
Activate Conqueror's Foothold's fourth ability by paying {6} and tapping it, returning Rude Awakening from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
